qa.overall_assessment: PASS. The Cycle 6 fix removes the WEB_TABLET_MAX_WIDTH_CAP=800 constant and collapses the isRunningOnMac branch as specified. Live Playwright measurements at 1920×1080 (avatar.right=1906, delta 14px), 1280×800 (avatar.right=1266, delta 14px), and mobile 390×844 (avatar.right=376, delta 14px) all PASS the AC delta ≤ 20px constraint. The header content row's computed maxWidth tracks the formula `windowWidth - leftDrawer - rightSidebar` exactly: 1110px when right-sidebar is OPEN at 1920 (= 1920 - 360 - 450), and 1560px when CLOSED (= 1920 - 360). Toggle direction is mathematically and empirically correct: opening the sidebar SHRINKS the header (1560→1110, -450), closing the sidebar EXPANDS it (1110→1560, +450). All 6 ACs satisfied.
